north_star: Taowind Code core readiness depends on DWAC Core plus RCL Authority; external language models are optional accelerators and cannot compensate for missing execution evidence.
implemented: core readiness changed from 3 providers to DWAC plus RCL
UI setup separates required core from optional accelerators
Tao AI environment variables retained only as compatibility aliases
Game Router bound state separated from real engine readiness
hard_gates: RCL remains required for effectful actions
validation evidence cannot be replaced by generated text
browser-required goals need real browser observation evidence
unresolved native synthesis emits no fake changeset
truth_boundaries: No claim that DWAC native cognition can reliably generate arbitrary complex repository code without an external provider.
External AI is optional for system core readiness but may still be useful or necessary for capability-specific complex synthesis until native organs close those gaps.
DWAC native changeset generation fails closed when it cannot produce machine-parseable validated changes.
Game router availability is not equivalent to a ready installed Godot, Unity or Unreal executable.
GitHub Actions are not used for this change set.
